Question
========
What is the “Great Acceleration”?

Answerlist
----------
* A rapid increase in global resource use following World War I
* The exponential growth in socioeconomic and Earth system trends starting in the mid-20th century
* The sudden reduction in biodiversity in the early 21st century
* The rapid decline of industrialization during the 1960s


Solution
========
The “Great Acceleration” refers to the rapid and exponential increase in socioeconomic activities (such as population growth, industrialization, and resource use) and corresponding changes in Earth system processes that began around the mid-20th century.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
